title: Knights Tour Draft
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: KNIGHTS TOUR DRAFT
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Increasing lines; common pointer base 17125; exact end marker/EOF; byte-identical left/right payload
versions.unavailableReason: Source/development material; no self-contained stock Level II player is supplied.
versions.startupSource:
5 DEFINT A-Z
10 'KNIGHT'S TOUR
20 DIM  M(65,2)
30 M=1
40 FOR P=1TO8:READ X(P),Y(P):NEXT P
50    DATA -2,+1,  -2,-1,  -1,+2, +1,+2, +2,+1, +2,-1
60    DATA  -1,-2,  +1,-2
70 CLS
100 IF M=1 THEN   ELSE 200
110  M(1,2)=M(1,2)+1:T=M(1,2):IF T>1 THEN PRINT"NO SOULTION":STOP
120  X=2:Y=8
130       B(X,Y)=-1:M(1,0)=X:M(1,1)=Y:PRINT@X+X+X+Y*64-1,M;
